subject: Oceanography
title: Bathymetric Charts
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Bathymetric Charts.

hook.text: A bathymetric chart is the underwater equivalent of a topographic map—showing depth instead of elevation.

buildup.text: Contour lines connect points of equal depth—closely spaced lines mean steep slopes.

discovery.text: GEBCO (General Bathymetric Chart of the Oceans) has compiled global depth data since 1903.

twist.text: Between sonar tracks, scientists interpolate—so many 'mapped' areas are actually educated guesses.

climax.text: New high-resolution charts reveal features invisible at coarse resolution—canyons, faults, and landslide scars.

punchline.text: Depth lines on paper reveal mountains beneath the sea.
